# d-nd-seed

> A cognitive system for AI coders. Hooks, skills, memory, safety guards. Install it in your project — the AI coder reads it and configures itself.

Key guides:
- Boot system map: docs/boot_system_map.md
- Boot router pattern: docs/boot_router.md
- THIA to seed promotion lane: docs/THIA_SEED_PROMOTION.md
- Evolution transfer protocol: docs/evolution_transfer_protocol.md
- Installer option router: docs/installer_option_router.md
- Agent runtime translators: docs/agent_runtime_translators.md
- TM7-local TM1-function install: docs/tm7_local_tm1_function_install.md

## What it does

- Persistent memory across sessions (survives context compaction)
- Safety guard that catches destructive operations before execution
- System awareness at session start (repo state, API health, messages)
- 104 skills: 27 plugin, 33 for coding agents, 44 for chat AI (bilingual)
- Cognitive kernels that shape how the AI thinks (not just what it does)
- Godel plugin: inverted oracle that reveals hidden assumptions
- Parametric installer with profiles for different environments
- Capability registry + install planning via install.sh --plan
- Registry validation via install.sh --check
- Registry-gated install/update by default; --legacy-all is explicit bypass
- Agent runtime profiles: profiles/example-claude-code.json and profiles/example-codex.json

## Quick start

```
git clone https://github.com/GrazianoGuiducci/d-nd-seed.git
cd d-nd-seed
./install.sh profiles/example.json
```

## Key files

- GUIDE.md — AI entry point (map, setup, manual)
- install.sh — Parametric installer
- capabilities/registry.json — Routed capability metadata
- scripts/installer_option_router.js — Install plan generator
- scripts/validate_capability_registry.js — Registry validator
- templates/hooks/ — 19 hook templates
- skills/coder/ — 33 coding agent skills
- skills/thinker/ — 44 chat AI skills (IT/EN)
- kernels/ — Cognitive system prompts
- plugins/godel/ — Inverted oracle with domain configs
- plugins/d-nd-core/ — Core plugin (safety, awareness, messaging)
- docs/ — 33 operational guides

## Works with

Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini, and any AI coder that reads project files.
